svg.text: Spots are deconvolved. Cells get one label each — and the label inherits the segmentation.
One label per cell, plus a confidence
no marker on the panel → no call
Uncertain calls pile up at contacts
⚠️ Reference bias again (§1.2): a type missing from the reference — or from the panel — is forced into its nearest neighbour.
💡 Visium HD: an 8 µm bin can hold parts of two cells → RCTD 'doublet' mode, or rebuild cells first (bin2cell).
